title: Yiɗde e nder suudu ceniindu
intro: Aɗa naata e nder suudu deƴƴundu nduu, aɗa yi’a maccuɗo Alla dewondirɗo ina darii e juulde. Juuɗe maɓɓe ina njuuti, gite maɓɓe ina njuuti, ɓerɗe maɓɓe ina njogii yiɗde nde nguurndam mum fof yani. Hol oo nenta muñɗo mo hoolaare mum e Alla meeɗaani ustaade?
clues: Mi waɗii duuɓi juutɗi e dewal e duwaawu, miɗo seedtoo kaawisaaji tiiɗɗi goonɗinal am.
Mi hokkaama golle toppitaade suka barkinaaɗo e nder suudu ceniingu.
Nde mawnu mi, ko ɓuri mettude mi ko mi alaa ɓiɗɗo, sabu debbo am ko jom suudu, min ɗiɗo fof min njahdi e duuɓi.
Miɗo ñaagii Joomiraawo am lomto am e nder galle am, jogorɗo jokkude lefol annabaagal.
Nde ngon-mi e daraade e nder niɓɓere juulde ndee, maleykaaji ɗii noddi kam, mbi’i-mi, ‘Alla ina rokka ma kabaaru belɗo’, miɗo fiyi kulol e kulol.
Mi wi’aama mi daña ɓiɗɗo gorko ina wiyee Yahya, innde nde meeɗaani rokkeede hay gooto, kadi ko maande mi haaldataa e yimɓe balɗe tati.

arabic: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا
verse: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir (19:5)
